title: Nelson & Abel Tasman
meta_desc: Discover Nelson & Abel Tasman with kids in August 2026. Enjoy sunny weather, golden beaches, and clear water in NZ's sunniest region. Perfect for family holidays, with activities like water taxis, sea kayaking, and more.
intro: Nelson and Abel Tasman are perfect for a family holiday in August, with sunny weather, golden beaches, and clear water. As the sunniest region in New Zealand, it's ideal for outdoor activities like water taxis, sea kayaking, and exploring the beautiful coastal tracks. With a budget of $220-400 per day for a family of four, you can enjoy a range of activities and accommodation options.

sections.heading: Weather in August
sections.body:
August is a great time to visit Nelson and Abel Tasman, with mild winter weather and average high temperatures of 13°C. It's an ideal time for outdoor activities like hiking, kayaking, and exploring the coastal tracks. The region experiences an average of 16 rainy days in August, so it's a good idea to pack waterproof gear and check the forecast before heading out.

The cooler weather also means that the summer crowds have dissipated, making it easier to find accommodation and book activities. However, it's still a good idea to book ahead, especially for popular activities like the Abel Tasman Water Taxi and Sea Kayaking.

sections.heading: What's On in August
sections.body:
August is a great time to experience the local culture and events in Nelson and Abel Tasman. The Nelson Saturday Market is a must-visit, with a range of stalls selling local produce, crafts, and souvenirs. You can also visit the Founders Heritage Park Nelson, which showcases the region's history and heritage.

The Farewell Spit Tour is another popular activity, which takes you on a guided tour of the spit and its wildlife. And for the kids, there are plenty of free activities like visiting Tahunanui Beach and exploring the Abel Tasman coastal track sections.

sections.heading: Best Activities for Families
sections.body:
Nelson and Abel Tasman offer a range of activities that are perfect for families. The Abel Tasman Water Taxi is a great way to explore the coastline and get to some of the more remote beaches. Sea Kayaking is another popular activity, which allows you to paddle through the clear waters and get up close to the wildlife.

The region is also home to some of the most beautiful and family-friendly beaches in New Zealand, including Kaiteriteri Beach and Tōtaranui Beach. These beaches offer safe swimming, playgrounds, and picnic areas, making them perfect for a day out with the kids.
list: Abel Tasman Water Taxi: $40-$60 per person
Tōtaranui Beach: free to access, DOC campsite on-site

sections.heading: Crowd Levels and Booking Ahead
sections.body:
While August is considered the low season in Nelson and Abel Tasman, it's still a good idea to book ahead for popular activities and accommodation. The region can get busy during the school holidays, so it's best to plan ahead and book your activities and accommodation in advance.

Some activities, like the Abel Tasman Water Taxi and Sea Kayaking, can fill up quickly, especially during peak season. And for accommodation, it's a good idea to book at least 2-3 months in advance to ensure you get the best rates and availability.
list: Book activities at least 1-2 weeks in advance
Book accommodation at least 2-3 months in advance

sections.heading: Practical Tips for Families
sections.body: Here are some practical tips for families visiting Nelson and Abel Tasman in August:
list: Pack waterproof gear and check the forecast before heading out
Book accommodation that offers family-friendly facilities, such as playgrounds and kids' clubs
Consider purchasing a DOC campsite pass for access to campsites and facilities
Download the Abel Tasman National Park app for up-to-date information and track guides
Bring sunscreen, hats, and warm clothing for the cooler winter weather
